title: For Trump’s Former Fixer, a Tortured Path From ‘Rat’ to Reconciliation
summary: The president has made peace with Michael D. Cohen, his onetime lawyer who turned against him. But contrary to Mr. Trump’s claims, Mr. Cohen has not recanted the testimony that helped convict his former boss.
